Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<div><template shadowrootmode=\"open\"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("hidden_content" = "reachable"), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
